lines.zh: 我浮在地面上走，脚不沾土。
lines.en: I move above the ground, feet never touching.
My shadow is violet.

lines.zh: 我飘过草地，草没被压弯。
lines.en: I drift over the grass without bending it.
At night I move a little faster.
I cross along the field ridge.

lines.zh: 我的衣摆在风里没有声音。
lines.en: My hem makes no sound in the wind.
Step by step, as if treading water.
I pass straight through the tree's shadow.

lines.zh: 我在月光下走，光穿过了我。
lines.en: I walk in moonlight and it passes through me.
I go around the far side of the fence.

lines.zh: 我的光在夜里忽明忽暗。
lines.en: My light waxes and wanes in the dark.
The dew shows no prints from my steps.
I hang an inch above the grass tips.
It's colder around me.
I look down at the grass below.
The night is long; I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在月光下很淡。
lines.en: My outline is faint in the moonlight.
I'm listening to the wind far off.
I lift a hand and let it fall.
A moth circles me.

lines.zh: 月光从我身上穿了过去。
lines.en: Moonlight passes straight through me.
Only insect song floats in the grass.
I turn to face the wind.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在地上，是淡紫的。
lines.en: My shadow falls pale violet on the ground.
I'm waiting for the night to deepen.
Dew has formed on the blades.
I wait for dew to crawl over this grass.
I count the lamps left in the fields.

lines.zh: 我听着自己的呼吸，很轻。
lines.en: I listen to my own breathing, very faint.
The moon has moved west.
You've seen me; don't panic.
I drifted up behind you.
My light falls on your face.

lines.zh: 你站在这里，不觉得冷吗。
lines.en: Aren't you cold standing here?
I hold a hand out before you.
I can't say your name.

lines.zh: 我从你的瞳孔里看回去。
lines.en: I look back at you from inside your own eyes.
You can't hear my voice.
Would you come a little closer.
Back away and I won't follow.
I lower my head, a little nearer.
Your lamp doesn't reach through me.

lines.zh: 这一夜还长，我们慢慢看。
lines.en: The night is long; let's take our time.
The breath you let out is warm.

lines.zh: 我散开了一块，又聚回来。
lines.en: A piece of me scatters and returns.

lines.zh: 我身上被穿出一个暗口。
lines.en: A dark gap is punched through me.
I draw back and hover.
The blow thins me.
I don't cry out, but the night wind changes.
I pull myself in.
My outline shivers.
I press the loosened corner of myself back in.

lines.zh: 我重新抓住自己的形状。
lines.en: I catch hold of my own shape again.
A wound like this will mend by night.
These are of no use to me.

lines.zh: 那味道在我面前停住了。
lines.en: That smell stops short before me.
I don't even have hunger.

lines.zh: 它落在地上，我看了它一会儿。
lines.en: It falls to the ground and I watch it a while.
My hand passes through it.
Keep it; you need it more.
The smell is too solid.
I don't eat; I only keep you company.

lines.zh: 它在我脚下发出一点光。
lines.en: It gives off a little light at my feet.

lines.zh: 那东西在我掌里凉下去。
lines.en: It cools in my palm.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我没有挡住你。
lines.en: You run into me and I don't stop you.

lines.zh: 你穿过了我，打了个寒战。
lines.en: You pass through me and shiver.
I scatter, then close again.
The bump shifts me half a foot.
I put a hand on your shoulder.
The night has turned colder still.
Neither of us makes a sound.

lines.zh: 我侧身飘开，冷气跟着我。
lines.en: I slide aside, the cold following me.
What you touch is cold.
I slowly gather myself.
She walks this night road too.
Our lights are different colours.
We hover side by side, very close.
She doesn't speak; neither do I.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在地上叠起来。
lines.en: Our shadows overlap on the ground.

lines.zh: 她的光是淡紫的，比我淡。
lines.en: Her light is a paler violet.
We turn and stand another way.

lines.zh: 风把我们两个的光吹在一起。
lines.en: The wind blends both our lights.
She heads into the field.
I stay on the road and watch her go.
I reach and it rises.

lines.zh: 它穿过我的手掌落下去。
lines.en: It falls straight through my palm.
I hold it and it goes cold.

lines.zh: 它穿过我的手指落回去。
lines.en: It falls back through my fingers.
It glows faintly in my hand.
I can't hold anything solid.
I push it to the roadside.
I won't carry this away.

lines.zh: 它在我的手心里慢慢变淡。
lines.en: It fades slowly in my palm.
I open my hand and it drops.
Something moved over there.

lines.zh: 我听见草丛里一声轻响。
lines.en: I hear a soft sound in the grass.
My light flares once.
I drift in that direction.
I can see a long way at night.
I don't mean to harm this.
I only want to be nearer.
I lower my voice.
It has stopped over there.
I stop beside it.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸在冷空气里散开。
lines.en: Its breath spreads in the cold air.
I reach a hand toward it.
I follow without speeding up.
It walks; I drift.
My shadow is ahead of it.
A patch of my light rests on its shoulder.
My glow lights a little of the road.
It has started walking faster.

lines.zh: 我的光罩住了它的肩膀。
lines.en: My glow settles over its shoulders.
The air by my hand condenses.
There's a fence ahead of it.
It stops at that fence.

lines.zh: 我的指尖在它后颈停住。
lines.en: My fingertips stop at the back of its neck.
I hover right beside it.

lines.zh: 我停在它影子的正上方。
lines.en: I hover right above its shadow.
I reach out and it's cold.

lines.zh: 我的手指穿进了它的衣服。
lines.en: My fingers pass into its clothes.
It pulls back; I follow.
That touch is light as nothing.

lines.zh: 我把身上的冷推到它身上。
lines.en: I push my cold into it.
It's shaking all over.
I touch it again.
I draw my hand back and my light dims.
It raises a guard; the cold gets through.
I don't really mean to hurt it.
A cold wind rises in the night.
I come into view out of the wind.

lines.zh: 我的光先把草照了一下。
lines.en: My glow lights the grass first.
Dew forms under my feet.
I raise my head and look at this land.
My shape isn't quite steady yet.
I try a step.

lines.zh: 我没有影子的时候也没有声音。
lines.en: When I cast no shadow, I make no sound either.
There's a lamp in the distance.
I go toward the lamp.
The night wind walks with me.
Tonight the whole of this ground is mine.
I settle gradually.
Dew beads on all the grass around.

lines.zh: 火把夜里照亮了，也烧到了我。
lines.en: Fire lights the night and catches me too.

lines.zh: 我落下去，形状散了一半。
lines.en: I fall and half my shape comes apart.
The water washes me apart.

lines.zh: 爆炸把整片夜都掀开了。
lines.en: The blast tears the whole night open.

lines.zh: 一根箭穿过去，留了个洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and leaves a hole.
That light collides with me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我也会淡下去。
lines.en: I don't eat, and I can still fade.
The lightning shows me for an instant.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，我抓不住自己。
lines.en: There's nothing here; I can't hold myself.
